title: Region rotation DR exercise orchestrator - Terraform playbook
creator: Miguel Santos
description: Implement an automated orchestrator and Terraform playbook to run planned region-rotation disaster-recovery exercises for Private (VPC) deployments. Goal: let platform operators declare a rotation window and have the system perform safe region evacuations, automated health checks, DNS/route updates, and rollback if any SLO regressions are detected. Must integrate with existing Terraform modules (per-region workspaces), remote state locking, and the Console observability hooks so drills appear in the same dashboards as production traffic.
technical_solution: Build a 'region-rotation-controller' service responsible for coordinating the drill. Components: (1) Terraform driver that uses per-region workspaces and remote state (S3 backend + DynamoDB lock) to perform controlled route updates and resource toggles; (2) orchestration layer (K8s job or Lambda step function) that sequences actions: traffic mirroring -> phased instance cordon -> kv-cache persistence -> route cutover -> synthetic traffic smoke tests -> metrics gate validation -> finalize/rollback; (3) health-check harness (Prometheus + synthetic probes + canary workloads) with SLO gates; (4) automatic rollback and post-mortem collector that uploads logs and run metadata to Confluence and attaches GitHub PRs for any infra changes made during the drill.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can kick off a region rotation from the Console or CLI with a single command
Terraform playbook runs use isolated workspaces and respect remote-state locks; no concurrent state corruption observed in tests
Automated smoke checks (latency p50/p95, error rate, token throughput) evaluate against baseline and enforce pass/fail gates
When a gate fails, the system automatically rolls back DNS/routing and restores cordoned nodes, with a recorded reason
Drill run artifacts (terraform plan/apply logs, metrics snapshots, rollbacks) are persisted to the drill run archive and linked in the ticket
No customer data is exfiltrated; all steps run within the target VPCs and adhere to KMS key usage policies
tasks: Audit current per-region Terraform modules and add explicit 'drill-mode' flags
Create region-rotation-controller prototype (K8s job + controller pattern)
Implement synthetic probe suite and SLO gate definitions for Private deployments
Add remote-state validation & lock-check step to prevent concurrent applies
Wire Console UI button + CLI command to trigger orchestrator
Run 3 dry-run drills in staging across two regions and document outcomes

notes: Trade-off: aggressive cache evacuation reduces risk of stale responses but increases transient latency. Chose snapshot+restore for initial drills to minimize impact.
We intentionally avoid automating DB replica promotions in this first iteration; those operations remain manual and out-of-band to reduce blast radius.
Operational UX: include a 'pause after cutover' option so SREs can run manual checks before finalizing a drill run.
Rollbacks should be idempotent; all Terraform changes must be reversible without manual state edits.
